recap_subtitle: Welcome, future AI scientists! Let's review the magical face filters, machine learning classifiers, voice recognizers, and hand-pose trackers we coded to teach computers how to see, hear, and think. Here is our 12-session summary:

sessions.title: Session 1: Face Detection & AI Concept
targets: Explore what Artificial Intelligence means
Use the Face Detection extension in PicToBlox
Recognize face coordinate centers using camera feeds
sessions.project: Face Scanner! Teaching the computer to detect your face and snap coordinate boxes around it.

sessions.title: Session 2: Designing a Face Filter App
targets: Set sprite coordinates to match face positions
Handle scaling based on face width
Revise broadcast signals on detection
blocks: go to X(get face X) Y(get face Y)
sessions.project: Funny Face Filter - Make custom mustache or wizard hat sprites follow your nose or head coordinates!

sessions.title: Session 3: Face Landmarks & Expressions
targets: Identify face landmarks points (eyes, nose, mouth)
Recognize happiness, sadness, or surprise emotions
Code expression logic checkers
sessions.project: Emotion Reader - A smart scanner that says 'Cheer up!' if you frown, and throws confetti if you smile!

sessions.title: Session 4: Machine Learning & Object Scanners
targets: Differentiate pre-programmed AI from Machine Learning
Detect everyday items using cameras
Count scanned items on screen
sessions.project: Object Scanner - Scan items on your desk (like cups, keys, or pencils) and hear the computer name them!

sessions.title: Session 5: ML Image Classifiers training
targets: Understand the Machine Learning Environment
Train custom images models with multiple classes
Classify elephants, giraffes, or face masks
sessions.project: Mask Checker - Train a model with photos to recognize and warn if a person is wearing a medical mask or not!

sessions.title: Session 6: ML Custom Object Detection models
targets: Draw bounding labels boxes on custom items
Train object recognizers with sample photos
Display bounding coordinates
blocks: get detected object X / Y coordinate
sessions.project: Stationery Tracker - Training your own ML box to detect and circle bottles or pens on your desk!

sessions.title: Session 7: ML Audio Classification & Voice Maze
targets: Train acoustic models with multiple sound samples
Code direction commands using voice tags
Solve maze games using vocal triggers
sessions.project: Voice-Controlled Maze - Steer a beetle through a complex maze using vocal commands: Up, Down, Left, and Right!

sessions.title: Session 8: ML Text Classification & NLP Smart Lights
targets: Explore Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Train text models with word intents
Control output scripts using typed phrases
sessions.project: Smart Lamp NLP - Turn virtual room lamps on or off by typing organic phrases like 'It is dark here' or 'Shut it down'!

sessions.title: Session 9: Body Pose Detection & Clown Makers
targets: Recognize human body coordinate skeletons
Develop body part counters
Animate props on hand/shoulder/head positions
sessions.project: Clown Suit Maker - Place funny virtual hats, bow ties, and clown noses onto active skeletal joints!

sessions.title: Session 10: Hand Pose Trackers & Finger Mazes
targets: Track 21 individual hand landmarks
Connect index finger coordinates to mouse movements
Solve mazes using finger coordinates
blocks: go to X(finger X) Y(finger Y)
sessions.project: Air Finger Maze - Guide characters through maze corridors by pointing your finger in front of the webcam!

sessions.title: Session 11: Rocketship Space Hand Pilots
targets: Track skeletal coordinates speed vectors
Trigger laser blasts when hands touch
Map vertical hand height to rocket fly height
sessions.project: Hand-Controlled Rocket - Steer a spaceship up and down in deep space by waving your palm, firing lasers on hand claps!

sessions.title: Session 12: Air Painting Canvas and Gestures
targets: Read coordinates of active fingertip joints
Toggle virtual pens on pinch triggers
Draw continuous lines in empty air
sessions.project: Air Painter - Write and draw glowing lines in empty air by pinching your fingers in front of your computer camera!
